description: This header file defines internal API function prototypes for the TLS Hand Shaker component within a security module. It includes APIs for starting, aborting, establishing, and managing TLS handshake processes, including key calculations and cipher changes.

methods.name: TlsHsoStart
methods.description: Starts the TLS handshake process on the specified object.

methods.name: TlsHsoAbort
methods.description: Aborts the ongoing TLS handshake process.

methods.name: TlsHsoAgree
methods.description: Handles the agreement phase of TLS, with an indication if the session is resumed.

methods.name: TlsHsoCalMasterSecret30
methods.description: Calculates the master secret for TLS 3.0.

methods.name: TlsHsoCalMasterSecret31
methods.description: Calculates the master secret for TLS 3.1.

methods.name: TlsHsoChangeCipherW
methods.description: Changes the cipher for write operations.

methods.name: TlsHsoChangeCipherR
methods.description: Changes the cipher for read operations.

methods.name: TlsHsoEngage
methods.description: Engages or activates the TLS handshake object.

methods.name: TlsHsoSaveFragHandshakeMsg
methods.description: Saves a fragment of handshake message buffer.

methods.name: TlsHsoStateTimerInvoke
methods.description: Invokes the state timer handler for timeout or state management.
